title: [Renseikai] Attendance Synchronization – Salesforce to Back Office – Absent to Attend saved – Cleared values reflected
description: AC 04 — Decision Table and Regression — A saved SF correction from Absent to Attend appears in BO with both absence fields blank and in Learner App as Attend.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Renseikai Salesforce; HQ Staff is logged in to Back Office.
Lesson RSK-SYNC-001 / Student O: Status Absent; Reason Traffic Issue; Notice No Contact.
steps_actions:
1. Open Student O in Salesforce and select Edit.
2. Change Status to Attend and select Save.
3. Open BO Collect Attendance for the same lesson and student.
4. Open Lesson RSK-SYNC-001 in Learner App for Student O.
steps_result:
1. Status Absent; Reason Traffic Issue; Notice No Contact are shown.
2. Salesforce shows Attend; blank Reason; blank Notice.
3. BO shows Attend; blank Reason; blank Notice.
4. Learner App shows Attendance Status Attend.
steps_data:
1. Lesson RSK-SYNC-001; Student O.
2. Absent → Attend.
3. Same Student Session.
4. Learner App Student O.

title: [Renseikai] Attendance Synchronization – Salesforce edit cancelled – Back Office and Learner App values retained
description: AC 04 — Negative Testing — Cancelling an SF correction does not create a partial BO or Learner App update.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Renseikai Salesforce; HQ Staff is logged in to Back Office.
Lesson RSK-SYNC-007 / Student U: Status Absent; Reason Traffic Issue; Notice No Contact in Salesforce and Back Office.
steps_actions:
1. Open Student U in Salesforce and select Edit.
2. Change Status to Attend and select Cancel.
3. Open BO Collect Attendance for the same lesson and student.
4. Open Lesson RSK-SYNC-007 in Learner App for Student U.
steps_result:
1. Status Absent; Reason Traffic Issue; Notice No Contact are shown.
2. Salesforce closes without saving.
3. BO continues to show Absent; Traffic Issue; No Contact.
4. Learner App continues to show Attendance Status Absent.
steps_data:
1. Lesson RSK-SYNC-007; Student U.
2. Absent → Attend; Cancel.
3. Same Student Session.
4. Learner App Student U.
